goal: Add source-backed design discovery, bounded librarian design context, docs-first visual design artifacts, and blocking aesthetic source-quality validation to the existing Provider generation route.
acceptance_criteria: Design research records multiple source-backed references, three distinct directions, one selected direction, design tokens, interaction principles, accessibility constraints, and anti-copying boundaries.
Design support receipts cannot authorize canonical visual evidence or public delivery PASS, and the Codex conversation Provider/local_packager route remains unchanged.
Frontend and assembled-project validation reject missing tokens, responsive behavior, focus treatment, interaction feedback, design documentation, or source-to-design traceability.
Only a bounded design context enters frontend, media, and docs leaves through the existing generation-context librarian.
Design research artifacts are written before Provider source generation, and the generated project must include design_research.md and design_system.md before assembly can pass.
The existing Provider route runs a separate design-research stage after product and technical research for projects with a visual surface.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: traceable design discovery and implemented visual-system quality for generated interfaces
quality_metrics.target: every visual project has at least three distinct source-backed references, a selected design direction, bounded librarian context, docs-first design artifacts, reusable CSS tokens, responsive behavior, keyboard focus treatment, and visible interaction feedback
quality_metrics.method: design-research adapter tests, librarian projection tests, deterministic source-quality validation, Provider prompt contract tests, and live browser visual review on a generated sample

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: run_design_research executes after market research and before the existing Provider component generator; it writes support artifacts but cannot write or deliver the customer project.
apply_design_context_to_component_pipeline attaches one self-hashed bounded design context and required design docs without adding a component runner, generation route, or delivery exit.
build_generation_context_librarian_index exposes the design contract only to frontend, media, and docs owners and query_generation_context_librarian still enforces its item and character budgets.

validate_generated_design_quality feeds lower-case pass/fail blockers into existing component and assembled-project quality receipts while canonical browser evidence, user review, local_packager, and public delivery remain independent.

feedback: 172 targeted design/provider/kernel/management tests and the full 133-test generation usage profile passed.
A live network probe returned Openverse and npm reference candidates with provenance and reuse boundaries.
Browser review passed at 1280px and 390px with no console errors or horizontal overflow and with working evidence-trail feedback.

worked: A deterministic source-quality receipt caught generic shells before canonical browser evidence without pretending to judge final delivery.
Treating design as researched context plus an implementation contract let the existing librarian preserve bounded prompts while giving frontend leaves a coherent visual direction.
did_not_work: The first live search query mixed long goal text with search terms and returned sparse or invalid results; concise archetype queries and source-diverse ranking corrected it.
experiments: Measure first-pass visual acceptance on the next three real Provider-generated interfaces and tune only thresholds that correlate with browser and user review findings.
